name: learningmatter-mit/atomisticskills
description: AtomisticSkills MCP servers for atomistic simulation: materials science, chemistry, drug discovery and machine-learning interatomic potentials. Each package below is a container image; pass the server name as the first argument (e.g. `base`, `mace`, `matgl`).

packageArguments.name: server
packageArguments.description: MCP server to start. One of: atomate2, base, drugdisc, smol

environmentVariables.name: MP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API Key for Materials Project access. Required by base-server for querying bulk structures. Get a key at https://materialsproject.org/api

environmentVariables.name: OPENALEX_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email address to access the OpenAlex Polite Pool. Register your email for free at https://docs.openalex.org/how-to-use-the-api/rate-limits-and-authentication#the-polite-pool

environmentVariables.name: ELSEVIER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API Key for accessing Elsevier ScienceDirect API.

environmentVariables.name: ELSEVIER_INST_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional institutional token for Elsevier access.

environmentVariables.name: SPRINGER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API Key for accessing Springer Nature Meta API v2.

environmentVariables.name: UNPAYWALL_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email required for accessing the Unpaywall API to retrieve open access preprints and papers.

environmentVariables.name: ATOMATE2_REMOTE_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Default project name for remote job submission (auto-detected if blank). Required by atomate2-server.

environmentVariables.name: VASP_CMD
environmentVariables.description: Command to run VASP. Required by atomate2-server if running locally.

environmentVariables.name: PMG_VASP_PSP_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Path to VASP POTCAR directory. Required by pymatgen and atomate2-server.
